original_intent: Solve GitHub Issue #998 by moving Rust test implementations out of src so release builds contain production code and relevant runtime assets only.
derived_intent: Use out-of-line cfg(test) modules under tests/unit, preserve coverage, and prove cargo release and Bazel release graphs exclude tests.
next_transitions: run Decapod validation, verify todo, publish PR
active_boundaries: No inline test implementations in src; tests remain test-only; release targets include production src and relevant assets only.
evidence: Release binary target/release/decapod is a stripped 16,902,768-byte ELF; strings contains no migrated test module/helper symbols.
cargo test --lib ran 193 relocated tests; 192 passed and 1 failed on the pre-existing stale AGENTS.md entrypoint fingerprint fixture.
unresolved_assumptions: The entrypoint fingerprint failure is baseline because this change does not alter canonical templates or expected release constants.
